name: Chornobyl Quest
storyline:
The abandoned Exclusion Zone has become a dangerous wasteland where radiation, anomalies, mutants, and raiders threaten anyone who ventures into its ruins. As a stalker, the player enters the Zone to search abandoned laboratories, deserted towns, and military bases for resources, equipment, and valuable artifacts while uncovering the secrets hidden within the contaminated territory.

Survival requires more than simply exploring. The player must craft weapons and equipment, improve their base, and establish defenses capable of resisting waves of hostile creatures and raiders. Every expedition brings new dangers and resources, while the strange anomalies scattered throughout the Zone can either become deadly obstacles or sources of valuable artifacts.
summary:
Chornobyl Quest is a post-apocalyptic survival adventure set in the abandoned Exclusion Zone, where scarce resources, hostile mutants, raiders, and dangerous anomalies make every expedition a fight for survival. Explore ruined laboratories, deserted towns, and abandoned military bases while searching for useful materials, equipment, and mysterious artifacts.

Scavenge resources, craft weapons and gear, and strengthen your base with traps, turrets, and other defenses against waves of enemies. Anomalies can be deadly hazards, but they can also lead to valuable artifacts that can be used to improve your equipment and defenses.

With tactical combat, exploration, crafting, base defense, and offline gameplay, Chornobyl Quest combines survival mechanics with a top-down action experience inspired by the legendary stalker genre.
